div.head: Af 27
div.ab: Gif fædrenmæga mægleas mon gefeohte ⁊ mon ofslea, ⁊ þonne gif he medrenmægas hæbbe, gilden ða ðæs weres ðriddan dæl, ðriddan dæl þa gegyldan, for ðriddan dæl he fleo.
Gif fædrenmæga mægleas mon gefeohte ⁊ mon ófslea, ⁊ þonne gif medrenmægas hæbbe, gielden ða þæs weres ðriddan dæl [⁊ ðriddan dæl þa gegildan, for ðriddan dæl] he fleo.
Si quis ex parte patris sui cognatione carens hominem occidat, si ex materna cognationem habeat, reddat ipsa terciam partem compositionis, terciam congildones eius, pro tercia parte fugiat.
Gif fædrenmæga mægleas mon gefeohte ⁊ mon óflsea, ⁊ þonne gif medrenmægas hæbbe, gielden ða þæs weres ðriddan dæl, [ðriddan dæl þa gegyldan, for ðriddan dæl] he fleo.

If someone who has no paternal kin fights and kills someone, and if he nonetheless has maternal kin, let them pay a third portion of the wer, and his associates a third portion, and for the third portion let him flee.

If anyone who has no paternal relatives fights and kills a man, if he has any, he shall pay one third of the wergeld and his associates shall pay one-third. In default of the payment of the [remaining] third, he shall be held personally responsible.

Wenn ein an Vaterfamilie sippenloser Mann ficht und einen Menschen erschlägt, falls er jedoch mütterliche Verwandte besitzt, so entrichten diese des Wergeldes dritten Theil und ein Drittel die Gildegenossen; für [das letzte] Drittel fliehe er.

If a man without kin on his father’s side fights and slays a person, if he nevertheless has maternal kinsmen, let these pay a third of the wergeld and the guild-brothers a third; for [the last] third let him flee.
